verdict.rationale: Motion documents a REST API for creating, updating and managing projects and tasks, available to all users. A probe confirmed the API is live and enforces X-API-Key auth, so its core functions can be driven programmatically without the UI, for example from CI scripts. However, nothing documents a CLI, a headless or CI mode, or CI-oriented guidance, so the headless/CI story rests only on the API. Missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, CI integration docs or examples, scope of what the API can automate (e.g. scheduling, meetings), independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
